name: kiro-desktop-pet
description: A transparent always-on-top desktop pet launched and managed by KiroCrew on macOS.
author: Ethanvibe
highlights: Floats anywhere on the macOS desktop in a transparent always-on-top window
Uses the two bundled transparent character images
Click the pet to switch between business and casual skins
Drag the pet across the desktop and Spaces
Remembers the selected skin and screen position
Starts and stops automatically with the KiroCrew App
